description: 16 original cast identities, each in six expression panels. Reading order: calm, proud, afraid / angry, scheming, grieving. Owner identity and mood review pending.
common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original character portrait expression sheet for a Roman-era elemental-mage camp. EXACTLY SIX equal panels arranged in THREE columns and TWO rows, each showing the SAME person from upper chest to crown. Uniform head size and identical hair, costume, collar, skin and age in all six. Plain pale chalk-lime background with no scenery. Flat hand-painted fresco colour planes, broken umber contour, rubbed matte pigment, occasional tiny tessera marks at shoulder edges. Faces must remain expressive living drawings, not stone mosaics or sculpture. No photorealism, 3D, text, labels, numbers, watermarks, modern costume, magic effects, weapons or hands in frame. Leave clear gaps around each head for rectangular export. Panels fill an exact regular 3 by 2 grid without decorative frame.
